sketches.mechanism: Move semantics and the borrow checker reject use of a non-Copy value after ownership has been transferred.
sketches.resonance: Once the single thing is given away, the language itself refuses the fantasy that it is still possessed.

sketches.mechanism: A lexical binding is in the temporal dead zone while its initializer is evaluated, so reading it to initialize itself throws a ReferenceError.
sketches.resonance: It cannot bring itself into existence by reaching for the name it has not yet become.

sketches.mechanism: Void has no constructors, so a function from Void may return any type because no real argument can ever be supplied.
sketches.resonance: From the impossible, every answer is type-correct, but none can actually arrive.
sketches.draft:
import Data.Void
f :: Void -> a
f x = absurd x
